pages.text: The next entries list full programs shared by other MeatballCraft players. They were written for their authors' bases, so treat them as a starting point, not something that works as soon as you paste it.

$(li)Open a script's link and copy all of its text.$(li)In the Factory Manager, press $(l)Paste from clipboard$().$(li)Use the Label Gun to give your blocks the names the script uses, or rename them in the script.$(li)Read it first: it will move whatever it is told to, and trim any section you don't need.

Each link says how many labels the script needs. Scripts with $(5)EVERY TICK$() power sections cost more performance; their authors say so at the top of the file.$(br2)Each link opens the exact version reviewed for this pack. All of them passed SFM's parser unless noted, but none has been run on a real base here.
